Where do I even start?! I purchased a transmission for my 1 ton truck here, drove down to pick it up as they seemed to have had the transmission at a better rate than many of their competitors. So I made the 3 hour journey to their buisness. After I paid them 1100 dollars, brought it back to my mechanic that day, the transmission didnt fit my particular truck. I called back to this salvage yard repeatedly only getting a run around for several weeks. Finally, the owner calls me back after 3 (yes, THREE weeks.) and said that after doing a more thorough check that they didnt have my particular transmission and that they also were not going to give me back my money as they "have a no return policy" and wanted to offer me a yard credit of 1100 dollars. After some back and fourth that lasted nearly a month and a half and my attorney calling them, he finally agreed to give me back my money, but I was still out time, gas, and garage fees. These people in my opinion are scam artist. Save yourself a headache and Go somewhere else.
